title: GAUDA: Generative Adaptive Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion-Based Augmentation for Surgical Segmentation
mechanism: Joint LDM over compact (image, mask) latents; generation is targeted online at classes where a Bayesian segmenter's epistemic uncertainty is highest.
adaptation: Uncertainty per class from the 5-seed house ensemble; condition on class presence for inactive, splice, gridline, edge_dark, material; run offline in 3 rounds instead of online.
min_experiment: 3 rounds of uncertainty-targeted generation vs one-shot generation at matched count, on PF. Metric mIoU_rob. Kill: < +0.01.
evidence: R: +1.6 IoU CaDISv2, +1.5 IoU CholecSeg8k over comparable methods.
